outcome: Positive culture rates (urine, cervix, placenta, blood)
cohort: Pregnant women (453 with PPROM and 2004 with elective cesarean)
finding: While SIRS criteria fulfillment was significantly higher in the PPROM group compared to the elective cesarean group, considerable overlap between groups questions its utility in diagnosing intrauterine infection.
mod_finding: This study compared infection rates in women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) versus those undergoing elective cesarean delivery but did not investigate how mode of delivery related to other outcomes.
